We need solve

\[
12{,}500{,}000 \cdot n \equiv 111 \pmod{999{,}999{,}999}.
\]

Notice that

\[
12{,}500{,}000 \cdot 80 = 1{,}000{,}000{,}000 = 999{,}999{,}999 + 1.
\]

So

\[
12{,}500{,}000 \cdot 80 \equiv 1 \pmod{999{,}999{,}999}.
\]

Thus the modular inverse of \(12{,}500{,}000\) modulo \(999{,}999{,}999\) is \(80\). Multiplying both sides of the congruence by \(80\),

\[
n \equiv 111 \cdot 80 \pmod{999{,}999{,}999}.
\]

Compute:

\[
111 \cdot 80 = 8{,}880.
\]

Since \(8{,}880 < 999{,}999{,}999\), the smallest positive integer is

\[
\boxed{8880}.
\]

The answer is 8880.
